versions.changelog:
Cruise Package Calculator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Helps cruisers decide if drink, Wi-Fi, dining, photo, bundle, or add-on packages are worth buying, based on consumption and pricing.
- Provides clear break-even math, value score (0–100), and à-la-carte alternative cost for any major cruise line package.
- Customizable for families, bundles, and special scenarios, with automatic handling of gratuities and line-specific quirks.
- “Plain English” verdict and savings calculations, with actionable alternative suggestions if package isn’t a value.
- References official cruise line policies and historical pricing data for accuracy; always cites the source.
